title: Access Control List (ACL)
shortDescription: Access management via lists of grantees for each bucket and object
metaDescription: ACL in VK Object Storage: what access control lists for buckets and objects are, how and when they are assigned (at creation or modification), who can be a grantee (owner, other accounts/users, predefined groups), what types of permissions are supported, and how to apply predefined ACLs in typical scenarios.
